24	### Architecture fork — resolved: override `recommended-products/`, which removes the Cart port

27	`isFromExtends` returns true when the request names `@salesforce/retail-react-app` **and the issuing

33	`import RecommendedProducts from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/recommended-products'`

35	Base Cart is itself loaded by base `routes.jsx` via a relative `import('./pages/cart')`, which is not

43	`product-view` 6, `drawer-menu`/`list-menu` 2 each, `header`/`footer` 1 each). The single page port

265	
266	Input is what `use-einstein.js`'s `fetchRecProductDetails` produces: `{...rec, ...product, productId,

286	history, so `recs.length === 0` never fires and AC 8 is not implementable from the response. The gate
287	is a **local boolean**, not a copy of Einstein's list:
288	
289	```
290	hasRecentlyViewed = sessionFlagIsSet || isRegistered
291	```
292	
293	- `markProductViewed()` writes a session-scoped flag to `sessionStorage`, called from the existing
294	  Einstein `useEffect` in `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` (lines 772–801), alongside
295	  the `einstein.sendViewProduct` calls already there. One import, one call, guarded by the same
296	  `if (product)`.

300	end — **AC 6**. `isRegistered` short-circuits the local flag, so an authenticated shopper on a device
301	they have never browsed on still gets server-side history — **AC 7**. It is a strict improvement on
302	trusting Einstein alone: the SLAS `usid` can outlive a browser session, so this gate makes AC 6 *true*
303	rather than assumed.

## 2. Scale call

### Architecture fork — resolved: override `recommended-products/`, which removes the Cart port

Verified directly at `node_modules/@salesforce/pwa-kit-dev/configs/webpack/overrides-plugin.js`.
`isFromExtends` returns true when the request names `@salesforce/retail-react-app` **and the issuing
file is not itself inside `overrides/`**. The plugin's own comment (lines 116–127): *"This will return
true if the issuer is a file in a base template... This allow the base template to import from
overrides."* Implementation: `this.extends.includes(pkgName) && !filepath.includes(issuerPath)`.

Base Cart imports at `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/cart/index.jsx:36`:
`import RecommendedProducts from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/recommended-products'`
— a package-path import issued from a base file, so it **is** redirected once our override exists.
Base Cart is itself loaded by base `routes.jsx` via a relative `import('./pages/cart')`, which is not
redirected — so base Cart keeps rendering and picks up our override for free.

**Consequence: the ~2,460-line Cart copy-first (`index.jsx` 1515 + 8 real partials ≈ 948) is not
required.** This departed from adjudication item #10 ("we only have to copy-first for cart"), in the
direction of *less* work. **APPROVED by Marcel, 2026-09-06**, on the evidence that this is already the
dominant pattern in this repo: nine component overrides shadow base paths and are reached purely by
the resolver (`icons` at 64 base import sites — and mandated by AGENTS.md — `responsive` 12,
`product-view` 6, `drawer-menu`/`list-menu` 2 each, `header`/`footer` 1 each). The single page port
(`product-detail`) exists only because base `routes.jsx` loads pages by *relative* import, which the
resolver never redirects — a constraint that does not apply to components. Open Question 5 is closed.

**Caveat:** this is a *build-time webpack* resolver. It runs in the dev server and production build
only — **not** Storybook (`.storybook/main.js` aliases straight to `node_modules`) and **not** Vitest.

running app. That is why A1's pause is a hard gate.

five as an earlier draft of this plan stated:

| Base import site | Rails | Takes the new branch? |
|---|---|---|
| `app/pages/cart/index.jsx:36` | Cart Recently Viewed, Cart May-Also-Like | **Yes** (1 of 2) |

presence on PLP as scope creep.

hasRecentlyViewed = sessionFlagIsSet || isRegistered

8	import React, {useEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react'
9	import PropTypes from 'prop-types'
10	import {useIntl} from 'react-intl'
11	import {Button} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'
12	import ProductScroller from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-scroller'
13	import useEinstein from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-einstein'
14	import useDataCloud from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-datacloud'
15	import {useCurrentCustomer} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-current-customer'
16	import useIntersectionObserver from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-intersection-observer'
17	import {useWishList} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-wish-list'
18	
19	import {useToast} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-toast'
20	import useNavigation from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-navigation'
21	import {
22	    API_ERROR_MESSAGE,
23	    TOAST_ACTION_VIEW_WISHLIST,
24	    TOAST_MESSAGE_ADDED_TO_WISHLIST,
25	    TOAST_MESSAGE_REMOVED_FROM_WISHLIST
26	} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/constants'
27	import {useShopperCustomersMutation} from '@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react'
28	
29	/**
30	 * A component for fetching and rendering product recommendations from the Einstein API
31	 * by a zone or a recommender name.
32	 */
33	const RecommendedProducts = ({zone, recommender, products, title, shouldFetch, ...props}) => {
34	    const {
35	        isLoading,
36	        recommendations,
37	        getZoneRecommendations,
38	        getRecommendations,
39	        sendClickReco,
40	        sendViewReco
41	    } = useEinstein()
42	    const {data: customer} = useCurrentCustomer()
43	    const {customerId} = customer
44	    const {data: wishlist} = useWishList()
45	    const dataCloud = useDataCloud()
46	
47	    const createCustomerProductListItem = useShopperCustomersMutation(
48	        'createCustomerProductListItem'
49	    )
50	    const deleteCustomerProductListItem = useShopperCustomersMutation(
51	        'deleteCustomerProductListItem'
52	    )
53	    const toast = useToast()
54	    const navigate = useNavigation()
55	    const {formatMessage} = useIntl()
56	
57	    const ref = useRef()
58	    const isOnScreen = useIntersectionObserver(ref, {useOnce: true})
59	    const [_products, setProducts] = useState(products)
60	
61	    useEffect(() => {
62	        // Check if the component should fetch results or not. This is useful
63	        // when you are still waiting on additional data, like `products`.
64	        if (typeof shouldFetch === 'function' && !shouldFetch()) {
65	            return
66	        }
67	
68	        // Fetch either zone or recommender, but not both. If a zone and recommender
69	        // name are both provided, `zone` takes precendence.
70	        if (zone) {
71	            getZoneRecommendations(zone, _products)
72	            return
73	        }
74	        if (recommender) {
75	            getRecommendations(recommender, _products)
76	            return
77	        }
78	    }, [zone, recommender, _products])
79	
80	    useEffect(() => {
81	        // This is an optimization that eliminates superfluous rerenders/fetching by
82	        // keeping a copy of the `products` array prop in state for shallow comparison.
83	        if (!Array.isArray(products)) {
84	            return
85	        }
86	        if (
87	            products.length !== _products?.length ||
88	            !products.every((val, index) => val === _products?.[index])
89	        ) {
90	            setProducts(products)
91	        }
92	    }, [products])
93	
94	    useEffect(() => {
95	        if (isOnScreen && recommendations?.recs) {
96	            sendViewReco(
97	                {
98	                    recommenderName: recommendations.recommenderName,
99	                    __recoUUID: recommendations.recoUUID
100	                },
101	                recommendations.recs.map((rec) => ({id: rec.id}))
102	            )
103	            dataCloud.sendViewRecommendations(
104	                {
105	                    recommenderName: recommendations.recommenderName,
106	                    __recoUUID: recommendations.recoUUID
107	                },
108	                recommendations.recs.map((rec) => ({id: rec.id}))
109	            )
110	        }
111	    }, [isOnScreen, recommendations])
112	
113	    // The component should remove itself altogether if it has no recommendations
114	    // and we aren't loading any.
115	    if (!isLoading && (!recommendations || recommendations.length < 1)) {
116	        return null
117	    }
118	
119	    // TODO: DRY this handler when intl provider is available globally
120	    const addItemToWishlist = async (product) => {
121	        try {
122	            if (!wishlist || !customerId) {
123	                return
124	            }
125	            await createCustomerProductListItem.mutateAsync({
126	                parameters: {
127	                    listId: wishlist.id,
128	                    customerId
129	                },
130	                body: {
131	                    quantity: 1,
132	                    productId: product.productId,
133	                    public: false,
134	                    priority: 1,
135	                    type: 'product'
136	                }
137	            })
138	
139	            toast({
140	                title: formatMessage(TOAST_MESSAGE_ADDED_TO_WISHLIST, {quantity: 1}),
141	                status: 'success',
142	                action: (
143	                    // it would be better if we could use <Button as={Link}>
144	                    // but unfortunately the Link component is not compatible
145	                    // with Chakra Toast, since the ToastManager is rendered via portal
146	                    // and the toast doesn't have access to intl provider, which is a
147	                    // requirement of the Link component.
148	                    <Button variant="link" onClick={() => navigate('/account/wishlist')}>
149	                        {formatMessage(TOAST_ACTION_VIEW_WISHLIST)}
150	                    </Button>
151	                )
152	            })
153	        } catch {
154	            toast({
155	                title: formatMessage(API_ERROR_MESSAGE),
156	                status: 'error'
157	            })
158	        }
159	    }
160	
161	    const removeItemFromWishlist = async (product) => {
162	        try {
163	            const wishlistItem = wishlist?.customerProductListItems?.find(
164	                (item) => item.productId === product.productId
165	            )
166	            if (!wishlistItem || !wishlist || !customerId) {
167	                return
168	            }
169	            await deleteCustomerProductListItem.mutateAsync({
170	                parameters: {
171	                    customerId,
172	                    itemId: wishlistItem.id,
173	                    listId: wishlist.id
174	                }
175	            })
176	            toast({
177	                title: formatMessage(TOAST_MESSAGE_REMOVED_FROM_WISHLIST),
178	                status: 'success',
179	                id: product.productId
180	            })
181	        } catch {
182	            toast({
183	                title: formatMessage(API_ERROR_MESSAGE),
184	                status: 'error'
185	            })
186	        }
187	    }
188	
189	    return (
190	        <ProductScroller
191	            ref={ref}
192	            title={title || recommendations?.displayMessage}
193	            products={recommendations.recs}
194	            isLoading={isLoading}
195	            productTileProps={(product) => ({
196	                onClick: () => {
197	                    sendClickReco(
198	                        {
199	                            recommenderName: recommendations.recommenderName,
200	                            __recoUUID: recommendations.recoUUID
201	                        },
202	                        product
203	                    )
204	                },
205	                enableFavourite: true,
206	                isFavourite: wishlist?.customerProductListItems?.some(
207	                    (item) => item.productId === product?.productId
208	                ),
209	                onFavouriteToggle: (toBeFavourite) => {
210	                    const action = toBeFavourite ? addItemToWishlist : removeItemFromWishlist
211	                    return action(product)
212	                }
213	            })}
214	            {...props}
215	        />
216	    )
217	}
218	
219	RecommendedProducts.propTypes = {
220	    /* The title to appear above the product scroller */
221	    title: PropTypes.any,
222	
223	    /* The zone to request */
224	    zone: PropTypes.string,
225	
226	    /* The recommender to request */
227	    recommender: PropTypes.string,
228	
229	    /* The products to use for recommendation context */
230	    products: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.object),
231	
232	    /* Callback to determine if the component should fetch results */
233	    shouldFetch: PropTypes.func
234	}
235	
236	export default RecommendedProducts

21	/**
22	 * Renders a scrollable, horizontal container of products with native scroll

26	    (

50	            scrollRef.current?.scrollBy({

20	export class EinsteinAPI {
21	    constructor({host, einsteinId, siteId, isProduction, dnt}) {
22	        this.dnt = dnt
23	        this.siteId = siteId
24	        this.isProduction = isProduction
25	        this.host = host
26	        this.einsteinId = einsteinId
27	    }
28	
29	    /**
30	     * Given a POJO append the correct site and environment values
31	     *
32	     * @param {object} params
33	     * @returns {object} The decorated body object.
34	     */
35	    _buildBody(params) {
36	        const instanceType_prd = 'prd'
37	        const instanceType_sbx = 'sbx'
38	
39	        const body = {...params}
40	
41	        // The first part of the siteId is the realm
42	        if (this.siteId) {
43	            body.realm = this.siteId.split('-')[0]
44	        }
45	
46	        if (this.isProduction) {
47	            body.instanceType = instanceType_prd
48	        } else {
49	            body.instanceType = instanceType_sbx
50	        }
51	
52	        return body
53	    }
54	
55	    /**
56	     * Given a product or item source, returns the product data that Einstein requires
57	     */
58	    _constructEinsteinProduct(product) {
59	        // Handle variants for PDP / viewProduct
60	        // Assumes product is a Product object from SCAPI Shopper-Products:
61	        // https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/shopper-products?meta=type%3AProduct
62	        if (product.type) {
63	            // In case of variant, send the "sku" attribute
64	            if (product.type.variant) {
65	                return {
66	                    id: product.master.masterId,
67	                    price: product.price,
68	                    sku: product.id
69	                }
70	            }
71	
72	            // In case of variation group, send the "altId" and "type" attributes
73	            if (product.type.variationGroup) {
74	                return {
75	                    altId: product.id,
76	                    id: product.master.masterId,
77	                    price: product.price,
78	                    sku: product.id,
79	                    type: 'vgroup'
80	                }
81	            }
82	
83	            // Handle non-variant products, like master, set, bundle, item.
84	            // This code follows the implementation in the plugin_einstein_api.
85	            // https://github.com/SalesforceCommerceCloud/plugin_einstein_api/blob/c8168d5b8e2e34bfb9413da73969d59b0f3adabd/plugin_einstein_api/cartridge/scripts/helpers/RecommendationsHelper.js#L315
86	            return {
87	                id: product.id,
88	                price: product.price
89	            }
90	        }
91	
92	        // Handle variants & sets for PLP / viewCategory & viewSearch
93	        // Assumes product is a ProductSearchHit from SCAPI Shopper-Search:
94	        // https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/shopper-search?meta=type%3AProductSearchHit
95	        if (product.hitType) {
96	            return {
97	                id: product.productId,
98	                sku: product.productId, //TODO: Should we switch this to product.representedProduct.id once we allow non-master products in search results?
99	                altId: '',
100	                altIdType: ''
101	            }
102	        }
103	
104	        // handles non-variants
105	        return {
106	            id: product.id,
107	            sku: '',
108	            altId: '',
109	            altIdType: ''
110	        }
111	    }
112	
113	    /**
114	     * Given a cart item, returns the data that Einstein requires
115	     *
116	     * Assumes item is a ProductItemfrom SCAPI Shopper-Baskets:
117	     * https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/shopper-baskets?meta=type%3AProductItem
118	     *
119	     * This code follows the implementation in the plugin_einstein_api.
120	     * https://github.com/SalesforceCommerceCloud/plugin_einstein_api/blob/c8168d5b8e2e34bfb9413da73969d59b0f3adabd/plugin_einstein_api/cartridge/scripts/helpers/RecommendationsHelper.js#L315
121	     */
122	    _constructEinsteinItem(item) {
123	        const {product, productId, price, quantity} = item
124	
125	        // In case of variant, send the "sku" attribute
126	        if (product?.type?.variant) {
127	            return {
128	                id: product.master.masterId,
129	                quantity: quantity,
130	                price: price,
131	                sku: product.id
132	            }
133	        }
134	
135	        // In case of variation group, send the "altId" and "type" attributes
136	        if (product?.type?.variationGroup) {
137	            return {
138	                id: product.master.masterId,
139	                quantity: quantity,
140	                price: price,
141	                sku: product.id,
142	                type: 'vgroup',
143	                altId: product.id
144	            }
145	        }
146	
147	        // Otherwise send default attributes.
148	        return {
149	            id: productId,
150	            price: price,
151	            quantity: quantity
152	        }
153	    }

155	    async einsteinFetch(endpoint, method, body) {
156	        if (this.dnt !== false) return {}
157	
158	        const headers = {
159	            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
160	            'x-cq-client-id': this.einsteinId
161	        }
162	
163	        if (body) {
164	            body = this._buildBody(body)
165	        }
166	
167	        let response
168	        try {
169	            response = await fetch(`${this.host}/v3${endpoint}`, {
170	                method: method,
171	                headers: headers,
172	                ...(body && {
173	                    body: JSON.stringify(body)
174	                })
175	            })
176	        } catch (error) {
177	            logger.error('Einstein request failed', {
178	                namespace: 'useEinstein.einsteinFetch',
179	                additionalProperties: {error: error}
180	            })

182	        }
183	
184	        if (!response?.ok) {
185	            return {}
186	        }

188	        try {

390	    const getEventUserParameters = async () => {
391	        const usid = await getUsidWhenReady()
392	        return {

394	            customerId: effectiveDnt ? '__DNT__' : customer?.customerId,
395	            customerNo: effectiveDnt ? '__DNT__' : customer?.customerNo,
396	            guestId: effectiveDnt ? '__DNT__' : usid,
397	            deviceId: effectiveDnt ? '__DNT__' : customer?.customerId || usid,

431	        }

438	        },

import React from 'react'
import {
    Alert,
    AlertIcon,
    AlertTitle,
    CloseButton,
    Spacer,
    useToast as useChakraToast
} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'

/**
 * Display a toast message on the screen.
 * This is a custom hook to handle showing toasts in the app, preventing duplicate toasts and to add action elements
 * to toasts when required. It supports all props supported by Chakra toast.
 *
 * @param {string} title Message text to be displayed in toast
 * @param {string} id - id provided to the toast to avoid duplicate toast ids, use it if multiple toasts are needed
 * @param {string} status Semantic state of the toast - success | error | info | warning
 * @param {node} action Optional component to be displayed in the toast (eg. Button to allow user to perform action)
 * @param {string} position The placement of the toast on screen
 * @param {number} duration The delay before the toast hides (in milliseconds)
 */
export function useToast() {
    const toast = useChakraToast()

    return ({
        title,
        description,
        status,
        action,
        position = 'top-right',
        duration = 5000,
        variant = 'subtle',
        isClosable = true
    }) => {
        let toastConfig = {
            title,
            description,
            status,
            isClosable,
            position,
            duration,
            variant
        }

        if (action) {
            toastConfig = {
                ...toastConfig,

                render: ({onClose}) => (
                    <Alert status={status} variant="subtle" borderRadius="md" py={3} width="sm">
                        <AlertIcon />
                        <AlertTitle> {title} </AlertTitle>
                        <Spacer />
                        {action}
                        <Spacer />
                        <CloseButton onClick={onClose} />
                    </Alert>
                )
            }
        }
        toast(toastConfig)
    }
}

## What I did

Created exactly one file, matching step A1's manifest:

**`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/recommended-products/index.tsx`** (266 lines, new)

Copied verbatim from `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/recommended-products/index.jsx` (236 lines) and converted only what TypeScript required:

- `PropTypes.*` validation block → `type RecommendedProductsProps = {...}` (exact name required). Field order, optionality, and every original inline doc-comment (`/* The title to appear above... */` etc.) preserved verbatim; `PropTypes.any`→`React.ReactNode`, `PropTypes.string`→`string`, `PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.object)`→`readonly Record<string, unknown>[]`, `PropTypes.func`→`() => boolean`. Added `[key: string]: unknown` to model the untyped `...props` passthrough to `ProductScroller` (real base call sites forward Chakra style props this way, e.g. `mx={{...}}` in base `cart/index.jsx`/`empty-results.jsx` — confirmed by reading those call sites). `import PropTypes from 'prop-types'` removed.
- Component signature typed as `({...}: RecommendedProductsProps): React.ReactElement | null`.
- One new local type, `EinsteinRecommendationItem` (`id: string; productId?: string`), applied to every `product`/`rec` parameter. This was **required**, not optional — a bare `const addItemToWishlist = async (product) => {...}` with no annotation and no call-site context fails `tsc` with `TS7006` under this project's `strict` config, so `any` was never actually available as a silent fallback here. The shape is directly evidenced, not guessed: `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-einstein.js`'s `fetchRecProductDetails` (lines 465–520) reads `rec.id` before any merge (line 466, so `id` is always present) and sets `productId: rec.id` only on the successful-merge path (line 502), falling back to the raw, un-merged `reco` on its own catch (line 519) — hence `productId` modelled optional. Cited in the type's own docblock.
- `item` (wishlist items, `.find`/`.some` callbacks) also failed `TS7006` unannotated. Per AGENTS.md's Type Definitions rule ("don't re-declare types already exported by commerce-sdk-isomorphic... import them directly"), I did **not** hand-roll a type here — `useWishList` wraps `useCustomerProductLists` (`use-wish-list.js:8,17`), a real typed SDK hook, so I imported the real `ShopperCustomersTypes.CustomerProductListItem` from `commerce-sdk-isomorphic` (confirmed exported at `commerce-sdk-isomorphic/lib/index.cjs.d.ts` and `index.esm.d.ts`, both identical). This is a transitive dependency already resolved in `node_modules` (pinned via `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`), not a new package — nothing added to `package.json`.
- One `eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/unbound-method` on the `useIntl()` destructure, with a comment citing the exact existing precedent for this same rule on this same hook: `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:192–195`.
